title: Home Work 3: Single DB vs Master-Slave Replication
description: Сравнение производительности: Single Database vs Master-Slave Replication

targets.rawSql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    thread_count,
    AVG(CASE WHEN index_status = 'before' THEN response_time END) as single_db_latency,
    AVG(CASE WHEN index_status = 'after' THEN response_time END) as replication_latency,
    ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE index_status = 'before' AND success = true) / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(CASE WHEN index_status = 'before' THEN to_timestamp(timestamp_ms / 1000) END) - MIN(CASE WHEN index_status = 'before' THEN to_timestamp(timestamp_ms / 1000) END))))::numeric, 1) as single_db_rps,
    ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE index_status = 'after' AND success = true) / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(CASE WHEN index_status = 'after' THEN to_timestamp(timestamp_ms / 1000) END) - MIN(CASE WHEN index_status = 'after' THEN to_timestamp(timestamp_ms / 1000) END))))::numeric, 1) as replication_rps
  FROM jmeter_results 
  WHERE success = true
  GROUP BY thread_count
)
SELECT 
  thread_count as "Потоки",
  ROUND(single_db_latency::numeric, 1) as "Single DB Latency (мс)",
  ROUND(replication_latency::numeric, 1) as "Master-Slave Latency (мс)",
  single_db_rps as "Single DB RPS",
  replication_rps as "Master-Slave RPS",
  ROUND(((single_db_latency - replication_latency) / single_db_latency * 100)::numeric, 1) as "Улучшение Latency %",
  ROUND(((replication_rps - single_db_rps) / single_db_rps * 100)::numeric, 1) as "Улучшение RPS %",
  CASE 
    WHEN replication_latency < single_db_latency THEN 'Master-Slave'
    ELSE 'Single DB'
  END as "Лучше по задержке",
  CASE 
    WHEN replication_rps > single_db_rps THEN 'Master-Slave'
    ELSE 'Single DB'
  END as "Лучше по RPS"
FROM stats
ORDER BY thread_count

panels.title: 🚀 Сравнение Throughput: Single DB vs Master-Slave

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  thread_count || ' потоков' as metric,
  ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE index_status = 'before') / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(CASE WHEN index_status = 'before' THEN to_timestamp(timestamp_ms / 1000) END) - MIN(CASE WHEN index_status = 'before' THEN to_timestamp(timestamp_ms / 1000) END))))::numeric, 1) as "Single DB",
  ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE index_status = 'after') / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(CASE WHEN index_status = 'after' THEN to_timestamp(timestamp_ms / 1000) END) - MIN(CASE WHEN index_status = 'after' THEN to_timestamp(timestamp_ms / 1000) END))))::numeric, 1) as "Master-Slave"
FROM jmeter_results 
WHERE success = true
GROUP BY thread_count
ORDER BY thread_count

SELECT 
  thread_count as "Потоки",
  MIN(response_time) as "Min",
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY response_time)::numeric, 1) as "P50",
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY response_time)::numeric, 1) as "P90",
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY response_time)::numeric, 1) as "P95",
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY response_time)::numeric, 1) as "P99",
  MAX(response_time) as "Max",
  ROUND(AVG(response_time)::numeric, 1) as "Среднее",
  COUNT(*) as "Запросов"
FROM jmeter_results 
WHERE index_status = 'before' AND success = true
GROUP BY thread_count
ORDER BY thread_count
